craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra-adbhuta of tended glory through impurity — the Lord in wandering (v14 absent in data too: edition numbering gap, not a defect; L4 follows the L3 set). lines: Strong from expanse — power-Lord sung by truth-tellers;
